result.topic_en: Calculations on elliptic integrals: the integral of dy/sqrt((1-y^2)(1-k^2y^2)) is transformed by the substitution y -> 1/(ky) and by a linear fractional substitution into an integral over z with roots ±e^{±phi i}; this is followed by work on the equation Δu = μ²u in polar (log r, phi) coordinates and a small linear system in n_1,...,n_4.
result.transcription:
$\int_0^a \frac{dy}{\sqrt{1-y^2}\sqrt{1-k^2y^2}} = -\int_\infty^{\frac{1}{a}} \frac{\frac{dy}{k}}{\sqrt{y^2-1}\sqrt{\frac{y^2}{k^2}-[-k^2-]}} = [-+-]\int_\infty^{\frac{1}{ak}} \frac{dy}{\sqrt{(1-y^2)(1-k^2y^2)}}$
$a = \frac{1}{ak}$
$a = [-\ldots-]\, i\frac{1}{\sqrt{k}}$
$(y-\frac{i}{\sqrt{k}})z = \frac{i}{\sqrt{k}}(y+\frac{i}{\sqrt{k}})$
$-\sqrt{k}\,i z = \frac{y+\frac{i}{\sqrt{k}}}{y-\frac{i}{\sqrt{k}}}$
$-\sqrt{k}\,i y = \frac{z+\frac{i}{\sqrt{k}}}{z-\frac{i}{\sqrt{k}}}$
$(z-\frac{i}{\sqrt{k}}) \pm \frac{i}{\sqrt{k}}(z+\frac{i}{\sqrt{k}})\quad [-\ldots-](z-\frac{i}{\sqrt{k}}) + z + \frac{i}{\sqrt{k}}$
$z(1+\frac{i}{\sqrt{k}}) - \frac{i}{\sqrt{k}}(1-\frac{i}{\sqrt{k}})$
$- \quad - \quad +$
$(z-e^{\varphi i})(z-e^{-\varphi i})(z+e^{\varphi i})(z+e^{-\varphi i})$

$\int_0^{p+qi} \frac{dz}{\sqrt{(z-e^{\psi i})(z-e^{-\psi i})(z+e^{\psi i})(z+e^{-\psi i})}} = x+yi$
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = \mu^2 u \qquad x+yi = \int^{re^{\varphi i}} \frac{dz}{\sqrt{z(z-e^{\psi i})(z-e^{-\psi i})}}$
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = \left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{(\partial \log r)^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial \varphi^2}\right)\frac{d(\log r+\varphi i)}{d(x+yi)}\,\frac{d(\log r-\varphi i)}{d(x-yi)}$
$=\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{(\partial \log r)^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial \varphi^2}\right)\frac{\sqrt{r^2-2\cos(\varphi+\psi)r+1}\sqrt{r^2-2\cos(\varphi-\psi)r+1}}{r} = \mu^2 u$
$(1-e^{(\varphi+\psi)i}r)^{-\frac{1}{2}}$
$\sum \frac{e^{(\varphi+\psi)in}\,r^n\,\ldots}{\Pi n\;\Pi(-\frac{1}{2}-n)} = \sum \frac{\Pi(n-\frac{1}{2})}{\Pi n\;\Pi(-\frac{1}{2})}\, e^{(\varphi+\psi)in}\,r^n$ [?]
$n_1+n_2+n_3+n_4 = m_1$
$n_1+n_2-n_3-n_4 = m_2$
$n_1-n_2+n_3-n_4 = m_3$
[-$n_1 - \ldots = m_4$-]
$4n_1 = m_1+m_2+m_3+m_4$

methods.what: Substitution y -> 1/(ky) transforming the elliptic integral of the first kind
Linear fractional (Möbius) substitution relating y and z
Quartic with roots ±e^{±phi i} as the transformed radicand
Elliptic integral mapping z to x+yi
Transformation of the Laplacian under a conformal map into log-polar coordinates for Δu=μ²u
Binomial series expansion of (1-e^{(phi+psi)i}r)^{-1/2} with Gauss Pi-function coefficients
Solving a linear system with ±1 coefficients by adding the equations
